evidence.method: transform restated from the regular 1-D coordinates; CRS restated from the source
evidence.crs_from: the source COG (ausantarctic/gebco/GEBCO_2026.tif) declares EPSG:4326 (WGS 84), origin -180, 89.999999999999986, cell 0.0041666666666666666 degrees, 43200 x 86400, AREA_OR_POINT=Area (gdal.Open on each COG, GDAL 3.13.3, PROJ 9.9.0, 2026-11-28). the COG is made by github.com/AustralianAntarcticDivision/gebco from the GEBCO Compilation Group GEBCO_2026 Grid, a 15 arc-second grid on WGS 84 geographic coordinates
evidence.note: GEBCO_2026.tif states the origin latitude as 89.99999999999999, a floating-point rounding of 90; the transform restates it as stored; overview levels (<array>_x<f>, byterefs decision 0006) have no documents of their own: py/assertions.py applies this assertion scaled to each level
